glosses: To be supported by a fluid of greater density (than the object).
To be supported by a liquid of greater density, such that part (of the object or substance) remains above the surface.

examples.text: The boat floated on the water.
The oil floated on the vinegar.

glosses: To cause something to be suspended in a fluid of greater density.

examples.text: to float a boat

glosses: To be capable of floating.

examples.text: That boat doesn't float.
Oil floats on vinegar.

glosses: To move in a particular direction with the liquid in which one is floating.

examples.text: I’d love to just float downstream.

glosses: To drift or wander aimlessly.

examples.text: I’m not sure where they went... they're floating around here somewhere.
Images from my childhood floated through my mind.

glosses: To drift gently through the air.

examples.text: The balloon floated off into the distance.

glosses: To cause to drift gently through the air, to waft.

examples.text: Over the tree-tops I float thee a song, / Over the rising and sinking waves, over the myriad fields and the prairies wide, / Over the dense-pack’d cities all and the teeming wharves and ways, / I float this carol with joy, with joy to thee O death.

glosses: To move in a fluid manner.

examples.text: The dancer floated gracefully around the stage.

glosses: To circulate.

examples.text: There's a rumour floating around the office that Jan is pregnant.

glosses: To remain airborne, without touching down, for an excessive length of time during landing, due to excessive airspeed during the landing flare.

examples.text: That's a daft idea... it'll never float.

examples.text: I floated the idea of free ice cream on Fridays, but no one was interested.

glosses: To automatically adjust a parameter as related parameters change.

examples.text: The yen floats against the dollar.

glosses: To not be tied to a reference.

examples.text: The government floated the pound in January.

glosses: To not be tied to a reference.

examples.text: "Peg out a claim wherever you like and we will float it," was the substance of many a code of instructions sent by unprincipled men in the mining world of the colonies to the gold prospectors in Port Darwin.

examples.text: When pouring a new driveway, you can use a two-by-four as a float.

glosses: An elaborately decorated trailer or vehicle, intended for display in a parade or pageant.

examples.text: That float covered in roses is very pretty.

glosses: A floating toy made of foam, used in swimming pools.

glosses: Funds committed to be paid but not yet paid.

examples.text: Our bank does a nightly sweep of accounts, to adjust the float so we stay within our reserves limit.

glosses: An offering of shares in a company (or units in a trust) to members of the public, normally followed by a listing on a stock exchange.

examples.text: You don't actually need a broker to buy shares in a float when a company is about to be listed on the Australian Stock Exchange.

glosses: Ondoyer dans les airs.

examples.text: C’était un tohu-bohu ethnique. Dans le port flottaient les pavillons de toutes les nations, et plus de deux millions d’êtres humains s’y embarquaient annuellement.

examples.text: Il fait doux, il fait clair. L’hiver commence à peine et je ne sais quoi de printanier flotte dans l’air subtil.

examples.text: Près d’un stand de fruits et légumes d’Anono, l’homme au visage émacié flotte dans ses habits : « J’ai perdu quatre kilos, je n’ai plus ma force d’homme. Mais je préfère rester maigre comme ça pour ne pas être tenté par la faim. »

glosses: Ne pas conserver l’alignement des rangs dans la marche en parlant d’une troupe.

examples.text: […], ni la très-noble et très-sèche mademoiselle d’Hérouville qui flotte entre trente et cinquante ans, sans se décider à un chiffre tolérable.

glosses: Se manifester fugitivement, en parlant des expressions du visage.

examples.text: Devenue totalement sourde, cette cagole de Catherine ne leur prêtait nulle attention. Un mince sourire flottait sur son visage et elle lisait.

glosses: Pleuvoir.

examples.text: Il a flotté toute la journée.
